Maharashtra panel to review Pune-Nashik railway route alignment

The Maharashtra government has formed an expert committee to review the alignment of the proposed Pune-Ahilyanagar-Nashik railway route. This move revives hopes for the original alignment of the project. The committee's formation is expected to address concerns regarding the railway line.
